vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Fixes for a known vulnerability are proposed at once (no minimumReleaseAge) and merge themselves once ci-ok passes.

helm-values.description: Chart images are digest-pinned, so the customManager below owns them. helm-values cannot update a digest; it would move the tag and leave the digest stale.

customManagers.description: Digest-pinned images in the chart and the e2e harness. The forms are `<repo/name>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>`, or the keys `repository:`, `tag:` and `digest:` in that order, or `repository:` then `tag: <tag>@sha256:<digest>`. Official images need a namespace, as in `docker.io/library/<name>`. test/ is scanned because ignorePaths above replaces the preset list, which skips **/test/**. Dockerfiles are left to the dockerfile manager, so no image is extracted twice.

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days after a release before proposing it, so a bad release can be yanked first.
npm packages are pinned exactly and wait 3 days like everything else.
Images wait 3 days too, a re-pushed tag (a new digest) as much as a new tag. A registry that gives no timestamp is not held back for ever.

The Go minor comes from the flake (go_1_26 and GOTOOLCHAIN=local). The builder image follows patches only; a new Go minor changes flake.nix, go.mod and the Dockerfile together, by hand (hack/check-versions.sh).
Likewise the Node minor (nodejs_24 in the flake).

The Agent SDK and the Claude Code CLI move together, weekly, behind the eval gate: a person runs the evals before this merges (docs/releasing.md). hack/check-versions.sh holds the SDK 0.3.N and CLI 2.1.N to the same N.
assistant-ui moves in a weekly group that a person reads: its runtime API is what the chat UI is built on.

agentgateway sits on the request path to Anthropic (Spike G): weekly, and a person reads the release notes; the gateway-spike job reruns the spike against the new image. Today its one image is ghcr.io/agentgateway/agentgateway, pinned in the Makefile (AGENTGATEWAY_IMAGE) and, from Task 26b, the chart. The globs keep this rule on agentgateway if the image or chart moves to another name or registry, so it never falls to the automerge default.
Not Renovate's to move: our own images (released by CI; the chart pins their digests at release).
kind node images must match the kind from the flake.
A major update waits for a human. Everything else merges itself once ci-ok passes: GitHub does the merge (platformAutomerge), so the main ruleset decides what passing means.
